options.content:
This dashboard is built only from the reviewed `nauthilus_director_*` Prometheus surface. The implemented metric label allowlist is:

`backend_pool`, `direction`, `listener`, `maintenance_mode`, `mechanism`, `method`, `operation`, `protocol`, `reason_class`, `redis_mode`, `result`, `route`, `service`, `shard_tag`, `status_class`, `tls_mode`, `transport`.

High-cardinality or secret-bearing values such as usernames, recipients, client IPs, session IDs, request IDs, backend identifiers, backend nodes, raw Redis keys, raw errors, SASL blobs and tokens are intentionally not metric labels. Use `backend_pool`, `shard_tag`, `protocol`, `operation`, `result`, `reason_class`, `status_class`, `route`, `transport`, `mechanism`, `redis_mode`, `maintenance_mode` and `direction` to slice the dashboard safely across multiple director instances.
